Data to be released on Wednesday is expected to show underlying inflation rising at an annual pace of 3.6% for the third month running in August, well ahead of the RBA’s target range of 2% to 3%. [1]

Spanish inflation for September is due today, with consensus at 4.9%, and a hot print would test Lagarde's claim that price pressures are not becoming embedded, and with it the pound-to-euro rate's hold on 1.1660. [4]

The fundamental backdrop for USDJPY is being shaped simultaneously by tight US policy and the continued normalisation of Japanese policy. [2]

And both the Iran war and inflation appear to be massive liabilities that are blocking out other issues. [5]

Sources: [1] RBA interest rates: Reserve Bank hikes cash rate to... | The Guardian (theguardian.com)  [2] Daily technical analysis of EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD... - RoboForex (roboforex.com)  [3] Everything That Happened in AI Today (Monday...) | The Neuron (theneuron.ai)  [4] Pound-to-Euro Upside on ECB's Dovish Tilt (poundsterlinglive.com)
